ARGAS_TLI.Settings.ShowSheet.Name: Show indicator in Actor sheets
ARGAS_TLI.Settings.ShowSheet.Hint:
Adds a clickable chain icon to Actor-sheet headers. A small P exclusively identifies the Actor's prototype token.
Left-click: Breaks or enables the connection between token and Actor.
Right-click: Opens the configuration of the token or the prototype token.
Middle-click: Reveals the Actor in the sidebar.
ARGAS_TLI.Settings.ShowHud.Name: Show indicator in the Token HUD
ARGAS_TLI.Settings.ShowHud.Hint: Adds a clickable chain icon to the Token HUD when a token is selected. The icon is visible to Gamemasters only.
ARGAS_TLI.Settings.ShowDirectory.Name: Show indicator in the Actors sidebar
ARGAS_TLI.Settings.ShowDirectory.Hint: Adds a clickable chain icon next to each Actor name in the Actors sidebar. It always targets the Actor's prototype token.
ARGAS_TLI.Settings.ClarifyButtons.Name: Label buttons more clearly
ARGAS_TLI.Settings.ClarifyButtons.Hint: The “Update Token” and “Assign Token” buttons are extended with descriptions, and a warning dialog prevents unintentionally overwriting the prototype token.
ARGAS_TLI.Buttons.SceneSave: (Saves the changes only for the token in the scene)
ARGAS_TLI.Buttons.PrototypeAssign: (Overwrites the prototype with the values of the selected token)
ARGAS_TLI.Confirm.AssignBody: This irreversibly deletes the prototype's values and replaces them with the values of the selected token in the scene. Are you sure?
ARGAS_TLI.Status.TokenLinked:
Token is linked.
It shares all values with the Actor.
ARGAS_TLI.Status.TokenUnlinked:
Token is <u>not</u> linked.
Its own changes stay with it; unchanged values inherit from the Actor.
ARGAS_TLI.Status.PrototypeLinked:
Prototype token is linked.
New tokens share all values with the Actor.
ARGAS_TLI.Status.PrototypeUnlinked:
Prototype token is <u>not</u> linked.
New tokens keep their own changes; unchanged values inherit from the Actor.
ARGAS_TLI.Hint.OpenPrototype: - Right-click to open the prototype token configuration.
ARGAS_TLI.Hint.Reveal: - Middle-click to reveal the Actor in the sidebar.
ARGAS_TLI.Notice.EditingToken: You are changing only the TOKEN in the Scene.
ARGAS_TLI.Notice.EditingPrototype: You are changing the Actor's PROTOTYPE.
ARGAS_TLI.Error.NoPermission: You do not have permission to change this token link state.
ARGAS_TLI.Error.DocumentNotFound: The associated Token or Actor could not be found.
ARGAS_TLI.Error.ActorNotInSidebar: The Actor has no entry in the sidebar.
ARGAS_TLI.Error.UpdateFailed: The token link state could not be changed. See the console for details.
ARGAS_TLI.Error.ConfigOpenFailed: The token configuration could not be opened. See the console for details.
